responsibility: Implements GCC’s main gimplifier, the tree-lowering subsystem that converts front-end GENERIC trees into High GIMPLE. It manages gimplify contexts, temporaries, cleanups, switch/condition state, OpenMP/OpenACC region and clause handling, EH-aware lowering, built-in and special expression expansion such as va_arg, function-body gimplification and instrumentation wrapping, and the large set of expression/statement rewriting rules that establish the canonical GIMPLE form consumed by later lowering and SSA passes.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the main gimplifier described by gcc/gimplify.h: it performs full lowering from GENERIC trees into GIMPLE, managing gimplify contexts, body/statement rewriting, and language/OpenMP/OpenACC-specific lowering, rather than the narrower operand-repair helpers provided by gcc/gimplify-me.c.
